title: Build a website with AI
objective: Build a personal website with an AI build partner. Learn to prompt with structure, understand what makes up a web page, then take those skills into a project of your own.

project.description: A one-page website about something you care about: a team, your art, a cause, a business idea. You will build it up piece by piece as you unlock new checkpoints.

checkpoints.title: Introduction
checkpoints.description: Welcome to the world of web development with prompting. Tell us what you already know, then see what you will be able to build.

panels.caption: Welcome to the world of web development with prompting.
In this pathway you will build a website of your own, with an AI build partner that writes code from your instructions.
You decide what to build. The AI helps you get there. Along the way you will learn what makes a web page tick.

panels.caption: Every checkpoint on your map teaches one thing you can take straight into your project. Complete a checkpoint, then decide: keep learning, or go build.

checkpoints.title: Basics of Prompting
checkpoints.description: Learn what a prompt is and write your first prompts to build a page.

panels.caption: A prompt is an instruction you give to an AI. For a website, it describes what you want on the page.
Vague wishes get vague pages. "Make it nice" could mean anything.
Specific instructions get specific pages. "A header with my name and a paragraph about my favorite hobby" tells the AI exactly what to build.

steps.title: An About Me page

starterFiles.index.html:
About Me

Nothing here yet. Write a prompt to fill this in!

steps.instructions:
This is a sandbox. Nothing you do here changes your project.

Write a prompt that asks the AI to create a simple **About Me** page. Include:

- your name as a heading
- one paragraph about something you like
- a list of three favorite things

Run the prompt and see what comes back.

steps.title: Start your website
steps.instructions:
Now the real thing. This is **your project**, and everything you build here stays.

Decide what your website is about. Then write a prompt that asks for a first version: a heading with the name of your site and a paragraph that says what it is.

Keep it small. You will add more as you unlock checkpoints.

questions.prompt: Which prompt is most likely to get the page you want?

options.label: Add a heading that says Welcome and a paragraph introducing my dog-walking business

questions.prompt: In your own words, what makes a good prompt?

checkpoints.title: Structure of a Webpage
checkpoints.description: Learn the main parts of a web page and what HTML does, then give your site a header and footer.

panels.caption: Most web pages share the same skeleton: a header at the top, main content in the middle, and a footer at the bottom.
The header usually holds the site name and navigation links. The footer holds contact info and fine print.
The main content is everything in between: text, images, cards, forms. It is where the page does its job.
HTML describes what is on the page and how it is organized. Every heading, paragraph, and link is an HTML element.
Elements like <header>, <main>, and <footer> name the parts of the page. That helps browsers, screen readers, and the AI understand your page.

steps.instructions:
This recipes page has a header and a footer, but they are bare.

Write a prompt that changes **only the header and footer**:

- the header should add navigation links for Breakfast, Dinner, and Dessert
- the footer should show a copyright line and an email address

Check that the recipes in the middle did not change.

steps.title: Add a header and footer
steps.instructions:
Back to **your project**.

Write a prompt that adds a header with your site's name and a footer with a way to contact you. Say exactly what should go in each.

If the AI changes something you did not ask for, tell it to put that back.
